verdict.rationale: Published tensor throughput is a fair axis for a GPU, but nothing in the evidence pack states a TFLOPS or TOPS figure for the RTX 5070 Ti, with or without precision and sparsity qualifiers. The NVIDIA pages only describe AI features in marketing terms (DLSS, local AI models, inference backends). Community items cover memory bandwidth and CUDA core counts, which are not tensor throughput.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can size training and inference from published tensor throughput — TFLOPS or TOPS with precision and sparsity stated, not a bare marketing number
